cues.en: The other day, Kent Peck, the eminent, the all-father of test-driven development himself, said this. He'd like a text editor that only allows transformations of the abstract syntax tree. For Lisp's Emacs is that editor. ParaEdit is a wonder. And a struggle. I had a really hard time adjusting. And I quit several times.
cues.zh: 前几天，著名测试驱动开发之父 Kent Beck 本人说了这么一句话。他想要一款只允许对抽象语法树进行变换的文本编辑器。对于 Lisp 来说，Emacs 就是这样的编辑器。Paredit 是个奇迹。但也让人抓狂。我花了好大功夫才适应。期间我放弃过好多次。

cues.en: It took this quote from Technomancy to guilt me into working through the pain. What made me finally understand Paradit is realizing it is about treating the code not as text to be inserted and erased, but as a tree to be manipulated. Let's look at some cool stuff it can do. Saving excursion is a favorite pastime for Emacs list packers. Let's wrap these three functions.
cues.zh: 正是 Technomancy 的这句话，让我感到惭愧，从而坚持熬过了痛苦期。让我彻底搞懂 Paredit 的关键，是意识到它不是把代码当作插入和删除的文本，而是当作可以操纵的树。来看看它能做的一些酷炫操作吧。对 Emacs Lisp 黑客来说，保存游标位置是大家最喜欢的消遣。我们把这三个函数包起来。

cues.en: Notice how it wraps around the first S expression? And those next two. Slurp them in. And barf them out again. Slurping and barfing. Beautiful. How can you not like it? Okay, next example. Let's say just one of these predicates will do. I can raise it up. Now look again. Racing replaces the entire parent with the child. So if I erase this...
cues.zh: 注意到它是怎么包裹第一个 S 表达式的了吗？还有接下来那两个。把它们吸进来（slurp）。再把它们吐出去（barf）。吸入和吐出。太漂亮了。你怎么会不喜欢它呢？好，来看下一个例子。假设这些谓词里只要一个就行。我可以把它提升（raise）起来。现在再看一次。提升操作会用子节点替换整个父节点。所以如果我把它提升起来……

cues.en: Those other statements are gone. Instead, I use splice as expression killing backwards. Breaking out of the conditional. Very handy. Next. I have a conditional around the let statement. Let's say I need V and X in one of the predicates. So I need let first and then the when. Convolutes as expression to the rescue. Ha! Any time I found a use for that, I feel like a king.
cues.zh: 其他语句都没了。我改用向后删除的 splice as expression 操作。直接跳出了条件语句。非常方便。下一个。我在 let 语句外面套了一层条件判断。假设我在某个谓词里需要用到 V 和 X。所以我得把 let 放在前面，然后再放 when。这时候 convolutes as expression 就能派上用场了。哈！每次能用上这个功能，我都觉得自己帅呆了。

cues.en: Next example. Ctrl K usually kills to the end of the line. Paradit tries to keep your abstract syntax tree valid at all time, so it keeps the end paren. If I kill from inside the string, it keeps everything in order. This context over killing is something I got used to really quickly. Now I want it everywhere. If I kill here, it removes the entire thing.
cues.zh: 看下一个例子。Ctrl K 通常会一直删除到行尾。Paradit 尽力让你的抽象语法树始终保持有效，所以它会保留右括号。如果我从字符串内部开始删除，它会让一切保持正常结构。这种考虑上下文的删除方式，我很快就习惯了。现在我恨不得在所有地方都能这么用。要是我在这里删除，它就会把整块都删掉。

cues.en: And, paradit trying to maintain the validity also holds when I add a quote inside this string. It's escaped. If what I want is two strings, I use split as expression instead. I can spot a string, split as expression, pretty nice. Next up, some closure code. I had thought you had one require statement per import. You don't. Let's fix it. First, here's join.
cues.zh: 而且，Paredit 尽力保持结构有效性的特性，在我往这个字符串里加引号时也同样生效，它被转义了。如果我想要的是两个字符串，可以用 split as expression 代替。我可以定位到一个字符串，split as expression，挺好用的。接下来，看点 Clojure 代码。我原以为每个 import 只能有一个 require 语句，其实并不是，咱们来改一下。首先是 join。

cues.en: Unsurprisingly, it's the opposite of split. Okay, here we go. Multiple cursures. Join these. Kill the symbol. Indent. Done. That was episode 14. Hope you enjoyed it. Follow me on Twitter. And thanks for watching.
cues.zh: 不出所料，它就是 split 的反向操作。好的，我们开始，多光标操作，把这些 join 起来，删掉这个符号，缩进，搞定。这就是第 14 期，希望大家喜欢。欢迎在 Twitter 上关注我，感谢收看！
